gate: Blum 2019 processed archive metadata-only schema inventory
permitted_operations: verify exact SHA-256 before archive inspection
record member path, directory flag, uncompressed size, compressed size, CRC32, extension, top-level path
forbidden_operations: calculate Jeffries-Matusita or any other native/SymC metric
select samples or conditions based on values
promote Blum 2019 as a testbed from this inventory
construct chi_bio, Chi_bio, or Bio Chi
pass_rule: archive hash matches frozen source and central-directory metadata can be enumerated with zero member payload reads
fail_rule: hash mismatch, archive parse failure, or any requirement to inspect member payload to identify the archive structure
